bug_semantics: In seven OSPF Traffic Engineering / Segment Routing TLV parsers, a uint16_t loop accumulator (sum/len) is incremented by TLV_SIZE(), which is a uint32_t (TLV_HDR_SIZE + ROUNDUP(ntohs(tlvh->length), 4)). A crafted sub-TLV length near 0xffff makes TLV_SIZE() >= 65536; the add truncates/wraps so `sum < length` never becomes false while the for-increment still does tlvh = TLV_HDR_NEXT(tlvh) and walks off the LSA buffer. An adjacent OSPF peer can trigger that path with a Type 10/11 Opaque LS Update and crash ospfd (CWE-190 then CWE-125).
flaw_origin: The first public write of this parser pattern is cf9b9f77f638923f5a44fdd14ce2725631ffa526 (2018-01-18, Olivier Dugeon), which added ospfd/ospf_sr.c with get_ext_link_sid, get_ext_prefix_sid, and ospf_sr_ri_lsa_update using u_int16_t sum and `sum += TLV_SIZE()` plus for-increment TLV_HDR_NEXT. Those three loops survived (C99 u_int16_t→uint16_t rename only) until the 2026 fix. The other four patched functions (ospf_te_parse_te/delete_te/parse_ri/parse_ext_link) are later copies of the same pattern, first written in f173deb35206a09e8dc22828cb08638e289b72a5 (2021-01-05, same author), not a move of older TE show-path code. The 2020 (uint32_t) cast on TLV_SIZE() only made the truncation type match the CVE text; the wrap already existed because ROUNDUP(ntohs(length),4)+4 can exceed 16 bits.

Advisory mechanism: uint16_t accumulator truncates uint32_t TLV_SIZE() in seven OSPF TE/SR TLV parsers; crafted Type 10/11 Opaque LSA after OSPF adjacency causes OOB reads/crash. Finder credit: Kazuma Matsumoto (GMO Cybersecurity by IERAE).

Pre-fix parsers at d3e8aedb87671f38db59b0df908e25e1d4af027d^: ospfd/ospf_sr.c get_ext_link_sid:982 (uint16_t sum at 992), get_ext_prefix_sid:1060 (sum at 1069), ospf_sr_ri_lsa_update:1368 (sum at 1377); ospfd/ospf_te.c ospf_te_parse_te:2115 (uint16_t len,sum at 2122), ospf_te_delete_te:2344 (2351), ospf_te_parse_ri:2439 (2445), ospf_te_parse_ext_link:2752 (2759). Each loop does sum += TLV_SIZE() and advances with TLV_HDR_NEXT.

Pre-fix macros in ospfd/ospf_opaque.h: TLV_BODY_SIZE = ROUNDUP(ntohs(length), sizeof(uint32_t)); TLV_SIZE = (uint32_t)(TLV_HDR_SIZE + TLV_BODY_SIZE); TLV_HDR_NEXT = tlvh + TLV_SIZE. ROUNDUP(65535,4)=65536 so TLV_SIZE can be 65540, which wraps uint16_t.
